about: How much of each selected passage a chat message quotes (docs/dev/ai.md 'Selected PDF passages'): one budget shared by all of them, a passage within an even share kept whole and what it leaves split evenly among the rest, the remainder going to the later ones. gamma/ai_context.py fair_shares and quoted_shares; frontend/src/chat/passageBudget.js fairShares and passageShares, which the chat's chips read. shares gives sizes and a budget; texts gives passages, counted in code points on both sides (a math letter such as U+1D465 is one character, two UTF-16 units), with kept their shares and total their lengths. Read by backend/tests/test_shared_fixtures.py and frontend/tests/passageBudget.test.mjs.

shares.note: the short one keeps all; the rest share
a tie: the remainder goes to the later one
short ones whole in any order, the long ones even
an even split of what is left, the remainder last
an empty passage leaves the budget to the rest

texts.note: math letters count one character each
a passage of math letters cut by code points
both go whole when their characters fit, whatever their UTF-16 length
